This is B.Sravani of 8th semester.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cb\u003EThis is an online E log platform to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent. I have been given this case in order to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of patient's clinical data analysis to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDATE OF ADMISSION - 10\/09\/23\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; CASE REPORT\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 45 year old female housewife residing in nakrekal came to OPD with chief complaints of 1)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003Eswelling in lower limbs since 4days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003E2) \u003C\/b\u003Eshortness of breath since 4days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003E3)\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;decreased\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;urine output since 1day\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 4 days back when she developed decresed urine output since 1 days which is insidious in onset and gradually progressive and is\u0026nbsp; associated with\u0026nbsp; bilateral swelling of lower limbs extending up to knee .which is relieved on lying down .H\/O shortness of breath while walking since 3 days. C\/O fever since 3 days that is relieved on medication .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/O pain in right and left lumbar region which is nonradiating.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O vomitings ,chestpain ,hematuria .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EK\/c\/o diabetes mellitus since 8 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EK\/c\/o HTN since 3 days\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EN\/K\/C\/O TB, Asthma,CVD,CAD,thyroid
